security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown backticks, code fences, comments, and JavaScript regular expression matching. The confirmed concerns are low-severity third-party network dependencies for p5.js and Google Fonts in the template and instructions. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Generated artifacts load p5.js from a third-party CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a vetted p5.js copy, pin it with an integrity hash, or clearly document the external script dependency.

remediation.issue: The viewer template loads Google Fonts from external domains.
remediation.suggestion: Use local font files or a system font fallback when offline use or privacy is required.

content.value_statement: Generative art projects need clear concepts, reproducible seeds, and usable controls. This skill turns a theme into a p5.js artwork with an interactive HTML viewer.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Builds self-contained HTML artifacts from a viewer template.
Uses p5.js with seeded randomness for reproducible outputs.
Adds seed navigation, reset, regenerate, and PNG download controls.
Defines interactive parameters for particles, fields, colors, and motion.
limitations: Default templates load p5.js and fonts from external domains.
Complex animated sketches may need performance tuning in the browser.
It guides original work and should not copy a living artist style.
The viewer layout is opinionated and uses Anthropic-style interface elements.

use_cases.title: Prototype generative visuals
use_cases.description: Create a seeded p5.js concept from a theme, mood, or computational process.

use_cases.title: Build interactive art studies
use_cases.description: Turn a visual idea into an HTML viewer with sliders, color controls, and seed navigation.

use_cases.title: Prepare reproducible artwork demos
use_cases.description: Package an algorithm and controls into a browser-ready artifact for review or sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create original algorithmic art inspired by tidal memory. Include a short philosophy and an interactive p5.js viewer.

prompt_templates.title: Tune the controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Add interaction to a draft sketch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a generative artwork with sliders for density, noise scale, motion speed, and color balance. Keep seed navigation available.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an existing concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a visual direction without changing the core idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refine this generative art concept into a polished p5.js artifact. Improve composition, reproducibility, performance, and parameter naming.

prompt_templates.title: Create a seed gallery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced exploration across many reproducible outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an interactive generative artwork with a gallery mode for selected seeds. Preserve deterministic output and explain the algorithmic philosophy.

output_examples.input: Create art inspired by coastal erosion and memory.
output_examples.output: The result includes a philosophy named Tidal Palimpsest and an interactive viewer with seeded shoreline-like particle trails.

output_examples.input: Add controls for density, turbulence, and palette warmth.
output_examples.output: The viewer includes labeled sliders and color controls that update the artwork while preserving reproducible seed behavior.

output_examples.input: Show several variations from the same algorithm.
output_examples.output: The artifact supports previous, next, random, and jump-to-seed controls so users can explore reproducible variations.

best_practices: Start with a clear theme and let the algorithm express it through rules.
Keep seed values stable when comparing visual changes.
Review generated HTML before sharing artifacts that load external resources.
anti_patterns: Do not request direct imitation of a living artist or copyrighted work.
Do not add random parameters that do not affect the visual system.
Do not remove seed controls when reproducible output is required.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original p5.js generative art with a philosophy, parameter controls, and an interactive HTML viewer.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can the same seed reproduce the same artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill emphasizes seeded randomness so the same seed can recreate the same output.

faq.question: Does the viewer need internet access?
faq.answer: The default template loads p5.js and Google Fonts from external domains, so offline use needs local replacements.

faq.question: Can users export images?
faq.answer: Yes. The viewer template includes a download action for saving a PNG image.

faq.question: Will it copy existing artists?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs users to create original algorithmic art and avoid copying existing artists.
